productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I love this entire series! The paper is thick, therefore no bleed through (I've used both markers & watercolor pens so far with no issues.) The pages are all perforated so they are easily removed if one wishes. The art is beautiful, although quite detailed which I adore but if you want simple drawings, these probably won't work for you. There is also ample amounts of pages and pictures in each book. Between the thickness of the paper and the amount of pieces in each book, these are well worth the cost. I have four books from the series so far, and I will definately be purchasing more from this artist and series. If you enjoy fantasy art, imaginative pieces, detailed artwork that is mentally immersion, and a wide variety of choices; I wholeheartedly recommend any book from this series. For myself the concentration required while coloring this art is effective at relieving my anxiety & stress. This artwork is also great at igniting my imagination when I am stuck and need help with my own art (I am a writer & poet).If any of the above applies to you, it is my opinion that you can't loose with this series of coloring books.Without question, I will be purchasing more books from the series, and I hope others enjoy these as much as myself!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This book is absolutely stunning!  Joseph is my favorite Mythographic artist.  It's definitely been worth the wait.  I've been a bit disappointed in the few recent pre-ordered books.  Happily, this one definitely doesn't disappoint.  There are so many wonderful plays on the dragon theme.  I can't pick a favorite, and I've browsed through it probably at least half a dozen times, so far today.  I'm having very emotional reactions to this book, and I can't say why.  That's not very common for me...  I'd be perfectly happy if Joseph's next book was dragon-themed, too.  Although, I very much doubt that would happen.  And, I understand why, but I thought I'd put the idea out there.  ;). I'm very impressed by this gentleman's artistic growth.  I love the playfulness of the juxtaposition of world versus character sizes.  How the pictures are less detailed for the sheer sake of busy, and how everything seems intentional.  There's maturity here, without losing the charm and whimsy. There's so much to explore here. So many types of dragons here: traditional Asian  dragons, to cute and small, feathered and majestic, elegant and meandering, and battles hardened and compact.  And, so many more.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: My favorite Mythographic coloring book by Joseph Catimbang. A new Best!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: A new best for artist Joseph Catimbang!I had preordered this coloring book last year on September 18th, that is how much I enjoy his artwork in the Mythographic series of c/books.I received the c/b  about 12 noon here in California but just got a chance to look at it now in early evening. I think every page is a page I will enjoy coloring, and that isn't always the case in most coloring books. And I have over 250 coloring books from my 55+ years of coloring. My two favorites are page 13 (a winged beetle like insect design on leaves) and page 23 (a lovely mouse sword fighter standing on a cat's head - very simular to the "Mouse Guard" graphic novel series artwork by David Petersen.) This page number count includes the title page as I always color this page as well.The paper is still fairly thick, every page has colorable artwork, and I have quite a few different art mediums I am going to try using in this book. I have a new set of 180 qty "Zig Clean Color" brush pens by Kuretake I've been waiting for a good C/B to try them out. (C/B is my short hand to writing out the words for "coloring book".)From me a true Highly Recommend!!! coloring book to buy for everyone. Its a every engaging art style, each page has a "color me" feel which is one of Mr. Catimbang's many artistic skills. I only buy from a few favorite artists or publishers since last year when the overall quality of paper and artwork has declined. Enjoy!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Great paper. Great art. I only recently purchased my first Mythographic book and I’ve been coloring for years. I just couldn’t get past the hidden object gimmick and the uncolorable tiny details. Thankfully those hidden objects aren’t in this book.I am very selective with the books I buy. I’ve been into adult coloring for over 10 years and have less than 40 coloring books.I need to see what I’m buying. I won’t buy a book that I won’t want to color the majority of the pages in. Some of the pages in this book are unappealing due to repetitive elements. I would not enjoy coloring a hundred crystals. As cool as the idea of coloring a geode is, I wouldn’t enjoy coloring one surrounded by a hundred crystals. It would be repetitive and tedious.A few of the images give off strong AI vibes with objects I can’t identify and objects flowing into other objects. I’m not saying the images in the book are ai but some pages give off strong ai vibes. I can deal with empty space. But I don’t like it when artists ruin a beautiful image trying to fill empty space with nonsense.Another thing is some pages have super small details. I don’t know how these details are possible to color. I tried fine liners on some and even the super fine tips didn’t work because the details were too small. It’s a coloring book. It’s meant to be colored. I really hope the artist takes note of these seemingly obvious critiques. The coloring book has to be colorable.I posted a few example of pages that I cannot wait to color to help other people like myself that want to see what they are buying before they hit the buy button.

raw_products.bookDescription: Title: "Dragons of Legend: A Fantasy Coloring Journey"Description:Immerse yourself in the mythical world of dragons with "Dragons of Legend: A Fantasy Coloring Journey." This captivating adult coloring book, measuring 8.5x11 inches, spans 50 pages filled with a rich tapestry of dragon lore. Each page is a gateway into the legendary realms of both European and Chinese dragon mythology, intricately designed to ignite your imagination and creativity.European Dragons: Delve into the Western dragon domain, where you will encounter majestic, bearded dragons, each with their unique scales, wings, and fiery breath. These pages are a tribute to the classic European dragon, embodying power, wisdom, and a touch of ferocity. The intricate details of their barbed tails, expansive wings, and imposing figures make for a rewarding coloring experience.Chinese Dragons: Transition into the Eastern sphere, where the serpentine elegance of Chinese dragons awaits. These mythical creatures are depicted in harmonious scenes, intertwined with elements of nature, clouds, and traditional Chinese motifs. Unlike their European counterparts, these dragons symbolize luck, prosperity, and wisdom. Their elongated, ribbon-like bodies and delicate features provide a contrasting, yet equally engaging coloring challenge.Themes and Styles: Each page is a canvas of fantasy, blending elements like castles, mountains, celestial bodies, and mythical landscapes. The designs range from simple and serene to complex and detailed, catering to every skill level and mood. The book offers a balance of both full-page dramatic scenes and smaller, meditative vignettes.High-Quality Paper: Printed on high-quality paper, "Dragons of Legend" ensures a premium coloring experience. The paper is thick enough to prevent bleed-through, allowing you to use a variety of coloring mediums like pencils, markers, or watercolors.Perfect for Relaxation and Stress Relief: This book is not just an artistic endeavor; it's a journey into a realm of relaxation and mindfulness. The act of coloring these mythical creatures offers a peaceful escape from the hustle of daily life, reducing stress and stimulating creativity.Ideal for Dragon Enthusiasts and Fantasy Lovers: Whether you're a fan of dragon mythology, a fantasy enthusiast, or simply seeking a new coloring challenge, "Dragons of Legend" is the perfect addition to your collection. It makes a wonderful gift for friends and family who cherish the mystical and the mythical.Join us on this enchanting journey through the world of dragons, where each page brings a new legend to life under your creative touch. "Dragons of Legend: A Fantasy Coloring Journey" is not just a coloring book; it's a portal to a world of fantasy, waiting to be colored by you.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: AI Slop Poorly PrintedAI Slop Poorly Printed
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is AI slop poorly printed on poor quality paper and I'm disappointed in myself for buying it.There's an elephant with a trunk that loops back around to become a leg. About a quarter of the creatures have ram horns, many of which loop around to join back up with the head at both ends, blend in with the hair or background, or just end abruptly. Many of the creatures are cross-eyed or wall-eyed. There are unicorns that have two horns on one side of the head, or horns that become ears or hair. There's a horse with some sort of appendage sticking out of its side and a dragon with a growth on one wrist that becomes a tree branch. There are creatures with upward-pointing fangs on their upper lips, or that have bodies that make less sense the longer I look at them.This is a non-exhaustive list of problems I found quickly skimming through the book. I wasn't even trying very hard.The drawings are blurry, faded and pixelated, about the quality one might expect from a home printer, and not a particularly good one. The paper is thin for an adult coloring book and feels like poor quality to me. The back of each page is printed black, I presume to hide how thin the paper is, but it's so thin and faded that if you hold it up to the light you can still clearly see the image on the other side. Decent coloring books for adults tend to have thick, sturdy paper to allow the use of markers without warping or bleedthrough. The solid black also shows clearly just how light the ink is and is riddled with pale lines showing how poor the quality of the printer is.The book is superficially fancy-looking garbage made from stolen art. It's absolutely not worth the cost and I'm sending it back.
